name: Irwin Oakwood
original_name: アーウィン・オークウッド
source:
He is a gentle, good-natured young man who looks good in glasses. He is a model of earnestness and sincerity, and teaches nature magic at the academy.

Although he is a contemporary of Miriam and Gilbert, his talent was discovered at a young age, making his actual age considerably younger than his colleagues. He is heartbroken over the incident that occurred due to former master.
